checked: The four category terms are defined immediately in the list; reduction, reuse, recycling, and composting are explained before examples. Ordinary examples clarify organic matter and processing.
Segregation separates at the source; diversion avoids disposal. The four diversion methods explain what changes and give concrete procedures involving cups, jars, paper, and compost.
Accepted materials and available processes qualify recycling categories; special waste is excluded from ordinary residual waste. Trap #2 explicitly states that statutory recycling can overlap reuse.
